title: KPHarness: Co-Evolving Knowledge and Probing for Long-Horizon Gaming Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.27417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A failed gaming trajectory reveals that an agent needs intervention, but not necessarily how its execution harness should change. Effective harness adaptation therefore requires gathering diagnostic evidence, rather than merely proposing alternative recovery rules. We present KPHarness, a framework that adapts the external execution harness of a frozen vision-language-action model through knowledge-probing co-evolution. Recovery knowledge supplies context-specific intervention hypotheses that guide active probing; probe outcomes reveal when these hypotheses apply and provide evidence for refining both recovery knowledge and later probe selection. This reciprocal process allows the harness to improve not only which interventions it applies, but also how it investigates failures. KPHarness separates fast policy execution from a slow research loop that translates accumulated knowledge and probing evidence into bounded harness revisions. Eac

translated_title: KPHarness：面向长时程游戏执行框架的知识与探测协同演化
translated_abstract: 一条失败的游戏轨迹只能表明智能体需要干预，却未必能说明其执行框架应如何改变。因此，有效的框架适应需要收集诊断性证据，而不仅仅是提出替代性的恢复规则。我们提出了 KPHarness，这是一个通过“知识-探测”协同演化来调整冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型外部执行框架的方法。恢复知识提供上下文特定的干预假设以引导主动探测；探测结果则揭示这些假设何时适用，并为改进恢复知识以及后续探测选择提供证据。这种相互促进的过程使框架不仅能改进它所应用的干预措施，还能改进它调查失败的方式。KPHarness 将快速的策略执行与慢速的研究循环相分离，后者将积累的知识和探测证据转化为有边界的框架修订。
tldr: KPHarness 提出了一种知识-探测协同演化框架，通过恢复知识引导主动探测、探测结果反哺知识更新，使冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型的外部执行框架能够同时改进失败干预策略和失败诊断方式。
en_tdlr: KPHarness presents a knowledge-probing co-evolution framework where recovery knowledge guides active probing and probe outcomes refine knowledge, enabling the external harness of a frozen vision-language-action model to improve both its interventions and its failure diagnosis process.
